reviewer: AI-assisted visual inspection; not expert adjudication
scope: All 24 examples in sample_manifest.json inspected using full context, original crop and simulated 640 input crop. Only the selected target box was reviewed.

status_definitions.plausible: Visible object shape is compatible with the source label; this is not confirmation of material or expert label validation.
status_definitions.uncertain: Class cannot be confidently confirmed from this view, because of blur, deformation, occlusion or possible category ambiguity. Not a confirmed annotation error.
